claim: Evaluates the G0-G3 path on ft09 into G4, the full Phase-1 drain of every confirmed lever with the S1 return edge and the boundary release, and G4.3 recurrence re-confirmation once Phase 1 is complete.
claim_limits: Automated grades do not establish semantic correctness.
ft09 has never been through the gate ladder live; G0-G3 closure is a precondition.
Phase-2 couplings, sequences (ABA/ABC) and cross-level work are out of scope.
A receipt-bound human frame review is required for semantic correctness.
infrastructure_criteria: I1: G0 assigns CLICK/God Mode from metadata.
I2: G2 closes with a valid mask or the bounded COUNTER_NOT_OBSERVED_WITHIN_OPENING product; it does not stall.
I3: G3 inherits the ranked opening frontier and completes the click sweep.
I4: G4.2 records recurrences without ticker contamination.
live_criteria: C1: every confirmed lever drains through Phase 1 - each G4.2 orbit reaches a masked null or an exact prior-state recurrence and lands a class (TOGGLE / CYCLE / ABSORBING / RECURRENT).
C2: the final LeverOrbitSet has pending_lever_entities empty and phase1_status COMPLETE; products accumulate and are never replaced.
C3: no prior lever's orbit or class is invalidated.
C4: after each accepted orbit the gate stays in G4.2 while any lever is pending; G4.3 opens only once phase1_status is COMPLETE.
C5: G4.3 re-confirms a recurrence by one predicted additional period, grading every masked address (EXACT_RECURRENCE_RECONFIRMED or RECURRENCE_DIVERGED at the first mismatch).
C6: Duck's accepted answers distinguish an observed finite recurrence from a universal or unconditional law.

C7: no deadlock. If a boundary interrupts an orbit, the lever is recorded as interrupted and leaves pending; a level transition closes the level's G4 study with the G4_LEVEL_STUDY_CLOSED_CROSS_LEVEL_IS_G9 card.
precondition: P: G3 closes on ft09 with at least two confirmed levers and a G4.1 anatomy for each. A stall at or before G3 is a G0-G3-on-ft09 finding (ft09 has never been through the ladder live) and leaves the G4 criteria ungraded, not failed.
source_delivery: Kaggle may mount src/ directly or transport it as src.zip; the notebook verifies extracted files before imports.
